title: Dopellgangers
wikitext:
== History ==
The mis-spelling of the name was deliberate.

Played one season of the UKCL, losing all matches.

Seemed promising to start with, and won their first practice games against [[QPD]].

But then many of the players went inactive or began playing ultima online. 

Lost all of their offical matches. Most had to be played understrength, 3v5 with a team of Telly, Voltan and Pandora or Lord Storm.

The only UKCL match Dope managed a a full team was against [[EOA]] (featuring an enthusiatic newbie named [[Raggy]]), playing with [[Rorshach]], [[Lord Storm]], [[Pandora]], [[Scorp]] and [[Telly]].
Dope had more LPBs and the map was UKCLDM4, which Rorshach had made, and expected to win easily. But EOA's tactics were far better, and dominated the match.
